optimization_progress.interpretation: A zero retained update is an optimization stall or abstention, not successful hand refinement. Objective improvement alone does not establish reconstruction quality.

heldout_policy: All image position, velocity and motion gate targets on these frames excluded from fitting; temporal priors may update them
finger_update_temporal_semantics: Per-hand normalized first/second differences of the added masked finger correction include active/inactive boundaries; inactive values stay at baseline. Independently observed wrist-relative fast motion relaxes the penalty; no missing image targets or baseline trajectory smoothing are introduced.
support_transition_semantics: Opt-in bounded cosine correction collar outside original admitted support; no independent image coordinates are added. Both original and expanded support boundaries remain reported. Zero collar reproduces the previous support policy.
correction_velocity_budget_semantics: Opt-in loss on every modified edge: unknown wrist-relative finger correction steps above 1 pixel or 0.005 native estimated metres, or training-observed velocity discrepancy above baseline*1.05+0.25 pixels. Optional wrist-chain correction receives corresponding wrist bounds. Mean plus worst-edge loss discourages dilution on long clips; independent post-fit checks remain required.
correction_budget_safety_semantics: An optional fraction in (0,1] tightens only the internal training budgets: fraction pixels, fraction*0.005 native estimated metres, and baseline*1.05+fraction*0.25 observed-velocity pixels. The loss curvature and independent diagnostic thresholds remain unchanged; no held-out or missing image targets enter training.

support_boundary_motion.interpretation: Prediction-only support-boundary steps relative to each wrist, not reference-relative ACC or verified physical motion
support_boundary_motion.independent_motion_evidence: Full independent observations are used only after fitting for this report; accepted adjacent fingers require both accepted wrists and both accepted finger observations

original_support_boundary_motion.interpretation: Prediction-only support-boundary steps relative to each wrist, not reference-relative ACC or verified physical motion
original_support_boundary_motion.independent_motion_evidence: Full independent observations are used only after fitting for this report; accepted adjacent fingers require both accepted wrists and both accepted finger observations

limitations: Camera fixed; only bounded selected arm/wrist controls change
Reliability weights are not calibrated visibility probabilities
Image landmark agreement and smoother motion do not establish hidden-reference accuracy

independent_observation_provenance.insufficient_scale_anchor_policy: Only that hand receives zero new image targets; its continuous prior geometry and the other hand remain available. Scalar 1 is explicitly uncalibrated.
independent_observation_provenance.retargeting: One fixed raw-reference native/Ego 3D palm scalar per hand/clip, unchanged baseline native wrist depth, training-only fresh detector wrist lateral anchor. No per-frame scale, clamp, rotation fit or copied detector finger coordinate.
independent_observation_provenance.support_semantics: Shared detector wrist plus at least eight accepted finger points. Per-joint image support remains required. This heuristic does not establish true visibility, occlusion or confidence probability.
independent_observation_provenance.holdout_policy: Stride-5 detector coordinates/weights are excluded before crop/anchor/scale/gate construction. Unknown/heldout new image weights are zero; prior geometry remains. Observer inference, baseline and optional upstream smoothing remain transductive development inputs.
independent_observation_provenance.diagnostic_ablation: Unscaled 2D wrist translation is retained only for analysis; main retarget method was declared before neural rerun and is not chosen from evaluation scores.
independent_observation_provenance.mapping_limit: SOMA/full-body MHR anatomical landmarks and wrist definitions are approximate, not identical geometry.

original_geometry_adapter.mapping_limit: Approximate semantic correspondence; no equivalence of SOMA and full-body native MHR geometry is asserted.
original_geometry_adapter.coordinate_system: OpenCV camera: x right, y down, z forward; metres
original_geometry_adapter.targets: 3D model predictions projected into original-video pixels; not independent image detections
original_geometry_adapter.confidence_policy: Binary finite positive-depth source-image-and-frozen-crop admission; not visibility, calibrated confidence or reconstruction truth.
original_geometry_adapter.optional_model_signals: Crop presence and normalized-crop sigma are preserved without thresholding or visibility interpretation.
original_geometry_adapter.mirroring: No additional mirror; EgoHand anatomical outputs are already in source-camera coordinates.
original_geometry_adapter.missing_policy: Zero fitting weights on absent predictions; no interpolation, reindexing or invented targets.
original_geometry_adapter.holdout_policy: No fitting/validation frames are removed here; the same downstream original-frame holdout mask must be used for each method. Model image inference itself sees supplied frames.

independent_observation_provenance.camera_quality: Shared Track 1 estimate; native metric depth and scale are not calibrated truth.

observation_semantics: Independent MediaPipe image landmarks on SAM-wrist-seeded crops; reliability weights are not per-joint probabilities or measured visibility
intrinsics_status: received MoGe2 pinhole estimate in original integer pixel centers, not measured calibration

mesh_change_from_baseline_mm.interpretation: Change from baseline prediction, not error against true geometry
